# Ansible roles

Per-role documentation is generated by [docsible](https://github.com/docsible/docsible) into a `README.md` inside each role directory, so it renders when browsing that directory. This index links to them.

| Role | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [apps](../ansible/roles/apps/README.md) | Third-party APT repositories, snaps and flatpaks, all declared as data. |
| [base](../ansible/roles/base/README.md) | Locale, timezone, user account, kernel tuning and a portable initramfs. |
| [desktop](../ansible/roles/desktop/README.md) | GNOME desktop, fonts, dconf system defaults and Flatpak support. |
| [dev](../ansible/roles/dev/README.md) | Development tooling, Docker group membership and mise-managed runtimes. |
| [dotfiles](../ansible/roles/dotfiles/README.md) | Installs chezmoi and applies dotfiles at first login, never baking them in. |
| [firstboot](../ansible/roles/firstboot/README.md) | One-shot hook that adapts a generic image to the machine it was written to. |
| [hardware](../ansible/roles/hardware/README.md) | Laptop firmware, power and thermal packages, installed into every image. |
| [manifest](../ansible/roles/manifest/README.md) | Records what was actually installed and fails the build on drift from group_vars. |
| [seal](../ansible/roles/seal/README.md) | Strips machine identity and build residue so the artifact is a clean template. |
| [security](../ansible/roles/security/README.md) | Firewall policy, SSH hardening and unattended upgrades. |
